name: terra-observation-logger
description: A browser-only nature journal with integrated dates, starter names and JSON restore, plus a local photo-ID MOCK prototype: ephemeral multi-view images, optional manual administrative location, top-three and all-remaining ranked demo candidates, and an explicitly confirmed discovery-form prefill for review. No automatic save, persistent photos/location, schema change, image upload, real AI, GPS, geocoding, or publishing.
